line.name: DBL Baseball Bat
line.description: A bat-shaped figurado, '100% smokable,' double-wrapped. Wrapper-composition details conflict slightly between sources on which tobacco is 'primary' vs. 'accent' - recorded as found rather than resolved by guessing. One variant was explicitly marketed as a June 2019 limited edition; a Connecticut listing was noted as 'currently unavailable' at one retailer.
line.wrapper: Connecticut with Maduro accents, or San Andres Maduro with Connecticut accents (per the brand's own site); a separate 2019 'Maduro L.E.' review instead describes Maduro with Habano and Connecticut accents - flagged as a source discrepancy.
line.binder: Dominican, grown on DBL's own farm
line.filler: Dominican, grown on DBL's own farm
line.status: current (Connecticut variant); the Maduro 'L.E.' variant was explicitly limited edition (June 2019)
